fields.description: Master switch for both weekly reports below. Uses the same Bifrost instance configured in Bifrost Settings (base_url) but a separate credential — a virtual key, not the admin Basic Auth used there — since generating a report is an inference call, not a Management API read.
fields.label: Enable Weekly AI Reports

fields.description: A Bifrost virtual key scoped to whichever cheap model you want these reports to use. Created in your Bifrost dashboard, not in this app — Bifrost owns all provider credentials, same convention as Bifrost Settings.
fields.label: Bifrost Virtual Key

fields.description: The model name as configured behind that virtual key in Bifrost, e.g. gpt-4o-mini or claude-3-5-haiku. Sent as-is in the request body.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Caps each report generation call's max_tokens — a cost control, not a quality setting. Raise it if reports come back visibly truncated.
fields.label: Max Report Tokens

fields.description: Analyzes the last 7 days of Proxmox host/guest resource history, alerts, and backups — right-sizing suggestions, recurring issues, action items.
fields.label: Enable Proxmox Fleet Report

fields.description: Analyzes the last 7 days of this bench's own Host Health data (worker/job/service health, disk-full forecasts) — a separate report from Proxmox Fleet, never blended.
fields.label: Enable Host Health Report

fields.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses. Gets the full itemized report.
fields.label: Email Recipients

fields.description: Comma-separated list of WhatsApp numbers in international format. Gets only the one-line summary plus a link to the full report — see Summary on Weekly AI Report.
fields.label: WhatsApp Recipients

fields.description: A separate Meta-approved UTILITY template for this weekly-report message — distinct from Proxmox Monitor Settings' alert/recovery/digest templates since this one's body includes a link. Required for WhatsApp delivery; without it WhatsApp is skipped (email still sends).
fields.label: WhatsApp Report Template Name

fields.description: Base URL used to build the "view full report" link sent via WhatsApp, e.g. https://infra-dev.alfaedge.in — the report's own name is appended to it. Leave blank to omit the link (WhatsApp message becomes summary-only).
fields.label: Dashboard Base URL

fields.description: Runs the analysis immediately, independent of Enable Weekly AI Reports / Enable Proxmox Fleet Report above — those only gate the automatic Monday schedule. Requires Bifrost Virtual Key and Model to be set.
fields.label: Generate Proxmox Fleet Report Now

fields.description: Same as the button on the left, for the Host Health report.
fields.label: Generate Host Health Report Now
